runs.environment: clean-room: fresh venv, pinned requirements.txt, isolated from development environment

config.training_data: data/train_augmented.jsonl.gz (train.jsonl.gz + 6 targeted synthetic-noise generators, 2000 rows/type, seed=0, 59.9% growth)

runs.notes: Predictions generated by replaying every published row through the LIVE running service (results/load_test.py), not an offline shortcut. Grader report, hostile runtime check, latency bench, noise-type breakdown and calibration report for this same run are the other results/raw/dev-run-001_*.json files. claimed.latency_p95_s (0.368) is the stated-concurrency=16 result from results/latency_bench.json -- this environment has a single CPU core, so this number reflects single-core request queuing, not per-request model cost (concurrency=1 p95 is 0.026s; see results/raw/dev-run-001_latency_bench_concurrency1.json and README.md for the full explanation). We report the concurrency=16 number as 'claimed' rather than the more flattering concurrency=1 number because concurrency=16 is what we actually load-tested as the stated benchmark condition.

runs.model: cheap-path classifier trained on data/train.jsonl.gz (no augmentation) -- SUPERSEDED, kept only as the augmentation A/B baseline referenced in ANALYSIS.md / DECISIONS.md
runs.notes: Clean-to-noisy action gap 0.1262 (FAILED the <=0.10 bar). This run is the 'before' side of the augmentation A/B in ANALYSIS.md; it is not the submitted model.

Reproduced the published baseline numbers exactly (intent 0.3748, action 0.3913, macro-F1 0.4508, noisy gap 0.0743, top70 ratio 1.0) before building anything -- see EXPERIMENT_LOG.md entry 2026-09-08-01.
